title: Answer: no free will in what is wanted, since instincts generate desires and people execute algorithms

statements.text: Matter As Machine does not use the term free will, and holds that people do not choose what they want. Instincts do not force an animal to act against its will, they generate the desires that make it want to act, and these desires feel like a person's own. The site doubts that people decide what to want or when to be happy or depressed, and the project began from the question of how to prove that a person is controlled by an algorithm.

sources.quote: I claim that instincts do not simply make an animal do something. They generate the desires that make it want to act.
Do we really decide what to want or when to be happy or depressed? Maybe not.

sources.locator: how the project turned to physics
sources.quote: At some point I asked myself: how can I prove that I am controlled by an algorithm?
